decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans numbered:
Existing and Proposed Plans - Two storey rear extension - 01 REV -5
Existing and Elevation Plans - Two storey rear extension - 02 Rev -3
and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence.
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), Part 2 (2020) and the London Plan (2021).

Notwithstanding the non-material amendment hereby approved, other than condition 2 which is superseded by the above condition,  all other conditions relating to Planning Permission Ref: 79439/APP/2025/1131, dated 19-06-25 must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 79439/APP/2025/1131, dated 19-06-25 (Erection of two storey side and part single part two storey rear extension) to change flat roof element at rear of scheme into a sloping/pitched roof
